Title: Kiss of Lachesis and unique Loquipment

Messages.Author: Hakuron
Messages.Body:
Hi there,

can "Kiss of Lachesis" on  be used to acquire unique Loquipment, for example "Ankara Citadel"?

> Kiss of Lachesis
> 1
> +1 stealth action.
> Burn a retainer or a non-unique equipment card.
> Burn a retainer, ally or non-unique equipment card.
> Move a non-unique equipment card from any Methuselah's ash heap to this vampire. If the equipment card comes from your ash heap, pay half the cost (round down), otherwise no cost is paid.
>
> The Ankara Citadel, Turkey
> 2
> This equipment card represents a location and does not count as equipment while in play. Unique.
> Cards that cost blood cost this vampire half as much blood to play (round down).
>
Edit: Just realised the "new" wording. So it's not possible. Sorry, folks ...

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Hakuron wrote:
> Just to be sure:
>
> Living Manse is non-unique, so this "equipment" can actually be moved to the acting vampire?
>
> Thanks in advance!
>
Sure.

Don't forget to include the cardtext.

Name: Living Manse
Cardtype: Equipment
Clan: Tzimisce
Cost: 1 blood
This equipment card represents a location and does not count as an equipment card while it is in play.
The vampire with this location gets +1 bleed. He or she can burn this card before range is determined to end combat. A vampire may have only one Living Manse.
